message.content:
This editorial illustration is the cover of a magazine. Against a solid red background, the large black serif word "TEMPO" is centered at the top. Above it, white and yellow text reads, "Wawancara Musa Marzouk, 'Otak' Bom Bunuh Diri Palestina." Below the masthead, small white text states, "EDISI 22 - 28 April 2002."

Dominating the center are the large yellow block letters "SKANDAL BANPRES." A dark wooden or metal podium, featuring the gold Garuda Pancasila emblem on its front and two thin black microphones on top, stands in the lower half of the frame. Numerous stacks and individual bills of blue-toned currency, resembling 50,000 Rupiah banknotes, are scattered around and on the podium. Some bills are tucked into the letters of the main title. Some stacks are piled on the podium's surface, while others appear to be fluttering or falling in an arc from the right side. A barcode and price "Rp 14.750" are at the bottom left and right, respectively. The phrase "MAJALAH BERITA MINGGUAN" is printed at the bottom center. Vertical linear artifacts run through the entire image.
